data.name: Cli.Help
data.value:
UseControl: restrictions for standard Windows accounts. Run as administrator. uc status state of the service, of every restricted account and its games uc apply apply the configuration now (and turn restrictions back on) uc suspend [--yes] remove all restrictions until "uc apply" uc preview every rule that would be written, and why uc audit security check of this PC uc users list | add [--preset

] | move | remove uc preset list | add [--from ] | rename | remove uc games [status] who may play now and how much was played today uc games allow [--user ] [--now] hours of play (counted while a game runs); --now: from now on uc games lock [--user ] block now (with a schedule: until the end of the day) uc games mode manual|schedule games only when allowed, or by the schedule uc games schedule [list] | add - [--limit ] | remove days: mon-fri, sat,sun, weekdays, weekend, all uc games close on|off close games when games time is over uc games find [--add] look for game folders that are not blocked yet uc block folder [--category games|vpn|tools|other] uc block name [--category ...] uc block file [--category ...] by fingerprint: renaming does not help uc unblock folder | name | file uc allow folder a program folder that runs inside a blocked place uc allow remove uc access deny|allow [--rights read,write,execute,delete|full] [--users a,b] uc access remove uc ext allow|remove chrome|edge|firefox uc policy set chrome|edge|firefox uc policy remove chrome|edge|firefox uc config export | import uc install [--from ] install or update (run from the folder with the published programs) uc uninstall [--keep-restrictions] [--purge] [--yes] uc ping | help Commands that change a preset (games, block, unblock, allow, ext, policy) take --preset when there is more than one preset. Options: --json (status, preview, audit, games find), --lang en|uk
